== Acquisition ==
'''[[Skill trainer]]s'''
* [[Michiko]] ([[Kaineng Center]])

== Notes ==
* This skill creates a [[Spirit of Tranquility]].
* Enchantment durations are rounded down.
* Combines well with [[Nature's Renewal]] for an enchantment hostile environment.

== Trivia ==
* This spell is a possible reference to a [[w:Magic: The Gathering|Magic: The Gathering]] card of the [https://scryfall.com/card/3ed/221/tranquility same name], the effect of which is to "destroy all enchantments".
